What matters to you when picking a movie: Genre and actors. I look first for thrillers and then if those movies have good actors in them. If not, I skip them.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Rom coms or thrillers depending on my mood. I prefer thrillers, but a good rom com with good actors is always a nice change of pace.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: Westerns and action movies. Not interesting. I don't enjoy the loud, fast pace of action movies. Too much CGI and bad acting.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Good back story and keeps you guessing throughout the movie. I like to have characters relatable. Nothing that drags for half the movie.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Drama, comedies, thrillers. I enjoy drama movies because I enjoy the storyline in most of them. Comedies I enjoy because it relieves stress. Thrillers I don't watch often but I do enjoy them because it good versus evil in most of them.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: Scary movies, too much bad stuff in them.  I think there is too much satanic, or demons and ghosts for my taste.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Good reviews from friends, actors/actresses that I know, awards. Friends def help me choose movies, I am not the best with judgement on movies.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Romantic comedy, horror/scary, drama. I am drawn to comedy and love romance. I love to be scared out of my mind. And a good drama is always entertaining
Description of movies you tend to avoid: sci-fi, I just do not like the idea of aliens or something that is not real to me. It's hard for me to get into that kind of thing

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look for positive reviews and a good storyline. I don't typically care about the cast/director etc. Sometimes I look up the trailer first to see if I want to actually watch the whole thing.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I like mostly comedies because when I watch a movie I like just chilling while watching it. I also really like documentaries, especially if they're about cases that happened in real life because I find them fascinating.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I avoid horror movies. I don't like blood/jumpscares. Some are fine (like thrillers) but I don't like jumpscare/slasher/etc. I also don't love historical dramas; I find them boring.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look for movies that do not age over time and I usually prefer musicals to anything else. They should have 3 dimensional characters and they should inspire me to care about the characters.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy musicals because they tell the stories through songs. Some are classics like Les MIserables, while others are more contemporary like The Greatest Showman.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I avoid horror movies or movies that have a lot of jump scares or gore. Life is scary enough, I don't need to see it on the big screen.

What matters to you when picking a movie: When picking between movies to purchase I tend to choose movies that interest me, have good ratings and i know atleast one of the actors.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: The kinds of movies i usually enjoy  are scifi or fantasy or comedy because I have always been a big nerd.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: the kinds of movies i usually ignore are thriller and  horror movies because I dont like violence and they raise my anxiety and stress levels.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Good reviews, critically and popularly. auteurs and a good cast, although i do appreciate non actors too, as they can provide a certain cinema verite.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Documentaries, sci fi, horror, psychological drama and thrillers, crime, mumblecore all present either sufficient escapism, thought provocation, and entertainment that pique my interest.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: romance and musicals can be too saccharine for my tastes. comedies can be hit or miss. Bittersweet romance usually gets a pass, though.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Good storytelling, believably, good characters. Not formulaic, doesn't easily fit into a particular genre. I like things that are well written and not predictable. I like stories that are immersive.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Period pieces (historical) because I like to feel what it's like to live in a different time. War movies because I like the action and I like to see how characters respond under stress. Independent movies because I like something that is unpredictictable.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I don't like super hero movies because they are too formulaic and predictable. I don't like dumb action movies because they are also too predictable and don't make me think.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I love anything really as long it's well done and authentic. Doesn't have to necessarily have A list movie stars, just as long as it's quality.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Christopher Nolan is one of my all time favorites. Thrillers, action, mystery are some of my favorites. The Prestige in particular is one of my top 5 favorite movies of all time.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I try to avoid anime mostly just since that doesn't interest me. Although I do like some animated kids movies if they are well done.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I will look for a good story line and something that may be different than what is always out there.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I like comedies because when I watch movies I want to escape for the most part. I also like psychological thrillers because I like to see if there is a good twist.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I am not a big fan of science fiction movies, but if my husband wants to watch one I will.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I don't really purchase movies anymore, but if I do then I would want a movie I really love and that I could watch over and over again without getting sick of it.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I love fantasy movies, I love dramas that end good. I like action adventure movies. I love sci- fi, especially if it has new planets, new races, other worlds etc...I really love a lot of different kinds of movies. I love zombie movies or survival...end of the world or apoclypse movies.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I avoid black and white movies. I avoid comedies unless there is someone I really like in it. I usually do not like horror or westerns or documentaries. I dont like religious movies either.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look for those with actors and directors that I recognize or those that have better ratings. Additionally, those with better covers will interest me.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy movies with lots of gore and horror elements to keep me thrilled and on the edge of my seat. I also enjoy romance movies as they are typically sweet and I like romantic elements.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I typically don't watch movies centered around too much action like fighting, boxing, or war. I also tend to not watch movies that are musical in nature.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look for a movie that I think will have a good story. Interesting characters are good but I care the most about overarching themes. I love a movie that makes you think.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I tend to like sci-fi or anything with grand sweeping narratives. I like the exploration of what it means to be human and speculative technology, imaginings of various futures.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I don't watch romance, I usually find them to be unrealistic and cringe. I don't like horror unless its comedy horror.

What matters to you when picking a movie: The country of origin is my primary consideration when choosing  between different movies to watch though I never purchase them.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy South Korean films.  I watch exclusively South Korean films and television series and have done so for more than 25 years now.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I avoid comedies and reality television.  I dislike those genres and find them irritating.  I can find plenty to watch in other genres.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Story, cast, visual appeal and reviews are normally the things I look for. Overall vibe and acclaim is important as well.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Suspense, mystery. Because most are thought provoking and really let you think and ponder on about what could come next.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: Romantic, romantic comedies, stand up and regular comedies. Because most are not funny at all and are very very boring.

What matters to you when picking a movie: It must usually be a preferred genre and subgenre with reputable crew and a cast that doesn't annoy me. I have my preferred directors that are instant must-see.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I love thrillers and its subgenres. I especially love psychological and/or erotic thrillers. I'm open to new experiences and have extensive viewing experience across all genres and decades and countries.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I only avoid movies with an obvious political slant tied to the production, not the plot itself. Though it's rare for me to care about melodramas or musicals unless they're exceptional.

What matters to you when picking a movie: When picking between movies to purchase, the most important factor is whether or not I believe I will want to watch the movie multiple times. Am I going to get my money's worth?
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy almost all types of movies except particularly gory horror movies. I love movies across the board, and find myself watching all different kinds often.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I tend to avoid particularly gory horror movies. I find them stressful and anxiety inducing, and I'm already prone to being anxious so I try to avoid those. Less gory horror movies are usually okay, though.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look at the reviews, if it is a movie I have been wanting to see, the price of the movie, when it will be coming to a streaming service I have, and watch the trailer of it again to make sure I want to buy it.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I love comedies because they cheer me up when it's been a rough day. I also enjoy romantics because I get sucked into the story. My favorite genre is rom-coms.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I tend to avoid sci-fi movies because they tend to bore me and I end up doing something else instead of watching the movie.

What matters to you when picking a movie: The vibes, often times set up by the director. I have some favorites that have their own style. A lot of times they'll cast the same people.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I watch a lot of horror movies! I have since I was a kid so there's just a familiarity there and they can range from fun and goofy to genuinely terrifying.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I'm not very into romantic comedies, or really that many comedies nowadays. I used to enjoy them growing up, but they aren't the same anymore. Also, Marvel, I don't watch those.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I look for good movies that I know I will enjoy, I don't want to take a risk if I am buying a movie that it will be one i don't like.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I usually enjoy sci-fi because I like the idea of a separate universe or fantasy things that can't actually exist.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I tend to skip horror and romance movies because they are either too scary or I find them boring, respectfully.

What matters to you when picking a movie: Who made it - writer, director, cinematographer, actors, composers & the timing of when it comes out in the theaters
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy movies of all kinds but I tend to prefer Science-Fiction, Comedy, Comic, Animated, Thriller, Documentary, and Hard core Pornography
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I usually enjoy watching movies of all kinds but I tend to strongly dislike Gore, Musicals, Remakes, anything that ight involve dancing or Romantic Comedies

What matters to you when picking a movie: Movies that are fun, comedy, mystery, adventure, ones that make me laugh and or ones that are very fast action.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I pick movies that are entertaining, fund to watch, keep my interest, don't make me fall asleep, or are boring.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I usually avoid scary movies such as horror, or slasher, or brutal movies. I do not want to be scared, I want to be entertained.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I like to get the very brand new movies that just get realeased, I like checking the ratings and seeing what others have said about the movie.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: I enjoy comedy but I also enjoy watching documentarys which are my favorite choices if I have to pick a movie.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I am so not into horror at all , so I totally avoid even looking at new realeases, they just seem to be the same thing thats already been done or same story line.

What matters to you when picking a movie: I need a movie with either a good story that is a long 2 hour + action packed/pathological thriller OR a simple comedy that will make me laugh the whole time. It's one or the other.
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: Long movies with plot twists that really make you think. I like the movies that have a surprise ending and you try to go back and see if you could have picked up on anything from the beginning.
Description of movies you tend to avoid: I tend to avoid love movies. They are always the same story repeated time and again. I do not find much to enjoy about them so I just avoid them usually.

What matters to you when picking a movie: something that my entire family enjoy, laugh, and remember together. something that make us have a good feeling about and put us at ease
Description of movies you tend to enjoy: comedy because it makes us laugh together and enjoy spending time with one another. Comedy movies tend to put our mind at ease, no distraction other than laughing and enjoying the moment
Description of movies you tend to avoid: horror, don't like to be scared or watch glorified murders. better time spent watching something funny with my family that we can laugh and enjoy without being tensed.
